findings.title: None price/pct values in international_report.json (1 ticker(s))
findings.description: yfinance silently returned None for price or pct fields in international_report.json. Downstream analysis reading these values will compute wrong signals. Affected: ['^KS11']
findings.evidence: data/international_report.json: 1 entries with null pct or price
findings.proposed_fix: Add null-guard in the data fetch layer: skip or flag tickers that return None from yfinance rather than storing None.

findings.title: None score in sector_assignments.json (8 sector(s))
findings.description: Sectors assigned with None scores: ['Healthcare', 'Biotech', 'Financials', 'Cloud & SaaS', 'Materials', 'Technology', 'Cybersecurity', 'Consumer Staples']. Agent assignment decisions based on null scores may produce arbitrary sector priority ordering.
findings.proposed_fix: In rd_team_leader.py: filter out sectors with None scores before ranking. Treat None as score=0 or skip entirely.

findings.title: None canary readings: ['spy_pct', 'vix_level']
findings.description: yfinance failed to return data for SPY/VIX indicators: ['spy_pct', 'vix_level']. The canary uses these to gate all trading — a None VIX or SPY means the canary may have defaulted to GREEN when the market was actually stressed.
findings.proposed_fix: If SPY or VIX is None, default canary to ORANGE (fail-safe) and log the data gap rather than silently defaulting to GREEN.

findings.title: Stale data file: data/international_report.json (98h old, threshold 26h)
findings.description: data/international_report.json has not been updated in 98h. Expected refresh interval: 26h. Data from this file may be leading to decisions based on stale market state.
findings.proposed_fix: Check that the agent producing data/international_report.json ran successfully in recent logs. Verify its cron schedule is active.

findings.title: Stale data file: data/earnings_predictions.json (300h old, threshold 26h)
findings.description: data/earnings_predictions.json has not been updated in 300h. Expected refresh interval: 26h. Data from this file may be leading to decisions based on stale market state.
findings.proposed_fix: Check that the agent producing data/earnings_predictions.json ran successfully in recent logs. Verify its cron schedule is active.

findings.title: beat_rate data gap: 124 days at 0% coverage — consider paid feed
findings.description: yfinance has not reliably provided EPS beat rate history for 124 days. Coverage: 0% of sample. Recommend evaluating a paid data feed (e.g. Financial Modeling Prep, Polygon.io) for earnings history before live trading launch.
findings.proposed_fix: Evaluate Financial Modeling Prep /v3/earning_surprises endpoint or Polygon.io earnings data.
